One black compound path. White becomes empty space. Only enclosed holes up to this area are filled, measured at tracing resolution.

Use this to remove a solid background around your artwork.

Advanced artwork settings

Balanced keeps small shapes. Fine follows edges closely; Smooth simplifies. One SVG path per color; the background counts too. For batches, Maximum colors applies to one shared palette across all images. An image may use fewer colors.

Smooth only the outside boundary. Interior artwork keeps its detail. Choose Strong for a rough perimeter; it can soften small outline features. Retrace after changing this setting. A solid outer background must be removed to expose a curved coaster outline. Use CoasterPrint’s 3MF download to preserve this shared boundary for printing.

Remove tiny isolated or hairline color fragments within 3 tracing pixels of the outside edge. Interior artwork stays intact. Turn off to retain intentional small edge marks. Retrace after changing this setting.

Cover long or connected edge slivers with the main rim color, in SVG and 3MF. Seals the outermost 0.5% of image width (about 0.5 mm on a 100 mm coaster). Keeps the outside shape and empty space. Turn off for intentional multicolor edges. Retrace to apply.

Advanced model & file settings

A solid coaster base follows your artwork’s outline. The raised image sits on top. Set the width; we keep the proportions.

Choose Bambu 3MF for separate base and color parts. Image colors are assigned automatically. The base reuses the rim color. Match the slots to your actual spools before printing. Features below 0.01 mm may be cleaned during export.

Download & print

Choose 3MF with assigned colors, or free STL parts to assign filaments yourself.

Guests: 1 image at a time. Registered accounts with a positive credit balance: up to 6 images. Processing is free.

3MF downloads cost 1 credit per image: a 6-image batch costs 6 credits, including a ZIP of individual 3MF files. Processing multiple images does not spend credits. STL parts ZIPs are free.

IMAGE → SVG → 3MF. LET’S MAKE SOMETHING.

3MF preparation uploads model parts and printer settings for a private download. Original images stay in your browser.

Print base down: Keep the coaster on its base with the artwork facing up. Check layer 1 from below in your slicer to see the CoasterPrint.Com imprint.

Free · separate base and color parts. Extract the ZIP, import all STL files together as one object with multiple parts, then assign filaments.

Other download formats
Printer profile & batch downloads

For a batch of images, download a single Bambu project with each converted coaster on its own plate. Base and color parts stay grouped.

The default is a P1S / 0.4 mm starter profile from the supplied sample. To use another printer, choose your own saved Bambu project (unsliced, up to 64 MB). Printer and print settings are reused. Image colors create matching filament slots; matching template colors keep their material profiles, and new colors use the first non-support material profile. Its models, artwork and previews are not copied. The template stays in your browser.

Loading P1S / 0.4 mm starter profile…

Convert at least two coasters to create a multi-plate project.

Open the downloaded file as a project in Bambu Studio to keep the plates. Image colors and part assignments are included. Review printer/material settings and map the slots to your actual spools. Only completed 3D models are included. Up to 6 plates and 32 distinct filament colors per project; each coaster needs a 5 mm plate margin.

Opening your file in Bambu Studio

Batch profile: P1S / 0.4 mm starter

Bambu Studio import notice

Download the 3MF and open it as a project to keep its colors, parts and plates. SVG import alone does not set filament colors. A P1S / 0.4 mm starter profile is included; choose your own saved project for another printer.

If Bambu offers “geometry data only,” colors and plates may be lost. Geometry still loads, but manual filament assignments may be needed. Open as a project with the correct printer profile to retain automatic colors.

 Your original image stays in your browser.
Images and free STL processing stay in your browser. Preparing a 3MF uploads model parts and printer settings for a private, account-bound download. Original images are not uploaded.
